title: Quick Change (2013 film)

text.lead: Quick Change is a 2013 Philippine drama film directed by Eduardo Roy Jr. The film was screened in the Panorama section of the 64th Berlin International Film Festival.
text.plot: A story of suffering, acceptance, and hope, the film follows Dorina, a middle-aged trans woman, as she navigates the complexities of the world in search of her place.
text.cast:
- Mimi Juareza as Dorina Pineda
- Miggs Cuaderno as Hiro
- Jun Jun Quintana as Uno
- Francine Garcia as Hazel
- Natashia Yumi as Lavinia
- Filipe Martinez as Mamu
- Rolando Inocencio
- Sashi Giggle as Trixie
